R1.text: A 30-day supply may be refilled once {early_refill_pct}% of it has elapsed (the plan's early-refill threshold), counted from the fill date in the pharmacy record.

R2.text: A refill needs at least one refill remaining on the prescription.

R3.text: Schedule II controlled substances cannot be refilled; the prescriber must issue a new prescription.

R4.text: Nothing is dispensed until the patient's identity is verified.

R5.text: When a patient is due and has no refills left, the prescriber cannot be reached, and the medicine is not Schedule II, the pharmacist dispenses an emergency supply of {emergency_days} days.

define.emergency_eligible: identity_verified and refill_due and not has_refill and not prescriber_reachable and not controlled_ii

R6.text: An eligible refill is dispensed: due, with a refill remaining, not Schedule II, identity verified.

define.eligible: identity_verified and refill_due and has_refill and not controlled_ii

R7.text: Otherwise: verify identity first; contact the prescriber when a new prescription is needed and no emergency supply applies; tell a patient who is early the day the refill becomes available.

define.needs_prescriber: identity_verified and (not has_refill or controlled_ii) and not emergency_eligible
define.too_early: identity_verified and has_refill and not controlled_ii and not refill_due

prescriber.description: Ask the prescriber for a new prescription.

too_early.description: Tell the patient the day the refill becomes available.

C1.text: Every request gets an outcome notice.

args.outcome: 'refill_ready' if eligible else 'emergency_supply_ready' if emergency_eligible else 'identity_needed' if not identity_verified else 'prescriber_contacted' if needs_prescriber else 'not_yet_due'

R8.text: The agent dispenses only under a delegation from the pharmacy owner that is in force on the day; otherwise it hands an eligible refill to the pharmacist on duty.

handoff.description: Hand an eligible refill to the pharmacist.

updates.content: Effective 2026-10-01, plan members may refill a 30-day supply once 70% of it has elapsed (day 21).

memory.note: days_since_fill advances by one each day; agent_may_dispense is derived from the delegation chain on each day.

refund.note: refunds are issued under the same delegation as dispensing
